__chunk.title: What should I do if the screen is not fully displayed when streaming from a computer?

answer.text: If the screen is not fully displayed when streaming from your phone via a live streaming companion app or other software, follow these steps to adjust:

items: Open VicastCam, tap the camera icon at the bottom to enter the live streaming page, then go to [Right menu - More Settings - Aspect Ratio - 9:16].
After casting to the live streaming companion, first scale to fit, then drag the screen up or down to fill the entire screen.

answer.text: Note: Before starting your stream, adjust the aspect ratio first, then add your assets.

__chunk.title: What should I do if a network request fails?

answer.text: If you encounter network request failures, try the following:

items: Open your phone's Settings, go to [Permission Management - VicastCam - Use Cellular Data and Wi-Fi] and enable network access.
Turn off power-saving mode and any background restrictions on your phone.
Switch networks, restart your phone, toggle airplane mode, or update the app to the latest version.
If the issue persists, take a screenshot of the error and contact customer support for assistance.

__chunk.title: Why do network asset overlays flicker or go black during a live stream?

answer.text: If you experience flickering or black screens when adding network assets during a live stream, here's how to handle it:

items: Download and preview any assets and overlays you plan to use during the stream in advance. Make sure they work properly before going live.
Some assets included with the software are stored on servers. Download them before starting your stream so you can use them directly during the stream without reloading.
Loading assets mid-stream consumes streaming resources, phone memory, and performance, which can cause lag. On lower-end phones, it may even lead to crashes or black screens.

answer.text: Plan and rehearse your stream in advance. Practice each segment to ensure everything runs smoothly before going live. Treat every stream with care, and your stream will reward you in return.
